description: This file defines the interface 'ModuleConfigurationService' which extends a generic service interface for 'IntegrationModule' entities. It declares methods for retrieving integration modules based on a module name and by module code.

classes.name: ModuleConfigurationService
classes.description: The interface providing methods to access configuration modules.

methods.name: getIntegrationModules
methods.description: Retrieves a list of IntegrationModule objects filtered by the specified module name.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a specific IntegrationModule identified by its module code.
